articles.summary: WESTBOROUGH, Mass. – Kopin Corporation (NASDAQ: KOPN), a leading provider of application-specific optical systems and high-performance microdisplays for defense, training, enterprise, industrial, consumer and medical products, today announced it has received a $2.4 million order from a leading international thermal weapon sight manufacturer for its advanced OLED microdisplay technology. articles.title: Kopin Secures $2.4M Order for OLED Microdisplays for International Thermal Weapon Sight Program
